Name: Negative Hearts
Author: Asakohee
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/8c72nsf2/1.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
Negative Hearts is a  mod that extends Stardew Valley's relationship system down to −10 hearts.

In vanilla, friendship points cannot drop below 0. With this mod installed, relationships can deteriorate into negative territory — and content packs can add unique dialogue and events for each stage of that decline.

[b]What this mod does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Extends the friendship floor from 0 to [b]−2500 points (−10 hearts)[/b][/*]
[*]Displays broken heart icons in the social menu for negative relationships[/*]
[*]Shows a [b]10-tier relationship label[/b] on the dialogue jewel during conversations[/*]
[*]Supports negative heart [b]dialogue keys[/b] for Content Patcher packs (e.g. Tue-2, Fri-4)[/*]
[*]Allows fine-tuned control over [b]decay, talk gain, and gift values[/b] per heart range via config[/*]
[/list]
[b]What this mod does NOT do:[/b]
[list]
[*]Does not include dialogue or event content — that comes from separate content packs[/*]
[*]Does not change vanilla romance progression (dating, marriage, etc.)[/*]
[*]Does not alter any vanilla behavior above 0 hearts[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/6p6pYf5g/2.png[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]▌ Negative Friendship System[/b][/size]

1 heart = 250 points. The floor is −2500 points (−10 hearts). The ceiling is unchanged from vanilla.

[list]
[*][b]−1 heart and above[/b]: Neutral zone — vanilla behavior, config rules not applied[/*]
[*][b]−2 hearts and below[/b]: Negative zone — config rules apply[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]▌ Relationship Tiers[/b][/size]

A relationship label is shown on the dialogue jewel (bottom-right of the dialogue box).

[list]
[*][b]Broken[/b] — −10 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Hostile[/b] — −8 to −9 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Resentful[/b] — −6 to −7 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Cold[/b] — −4 to −5 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Awkward[/b] — −2 to −3 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Neutral[/b] — −1 to +1 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Warm[/b] — +2 to +3 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Close[/b] — +4 to +5 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Trusted[/b] — +6 to +7 hearts[/*]
[*][b]Cherished[/b] — +8 hearts and above[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]▌ Dialogue Keys for Content Packs[/b][/size]

Content Patcher packs can use the following key format for negative heart dialogue:
[code]Mon-2  Tue-4  Wed-6  Thu-8  Fri-10[/code]
Lookup priority (example: current −4 hearts on Tuesday):
[list=1]
[*]Tue-4_[year] (year variant, year 2+)[/*]
[*]Tue-4[/*]
[*]Tue-2_[year][/*]
[*]Tue-2[/*]
[*]Vanilla fallback (Tue, spring_Tue, etc.)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] Only even numbers are supported (−2, −4, −6, −8, −10). Odd keys like Mon-3 will not be read.

[size=4][b]▌ config.json[/b][/size]

Three rule sets can be configured per heart range:
[list]
[*][b]Decay[/b] — Friendship lost per day[/*]
[*][b]Talk[/b] — Friendship gained from talking[/*]
[*][b]Gift[/b] — Friendship change per gift type[/*]
[/list]
[spoiler]
[code]{
  "Decay": [
    { "From": -4, "To": 0, "PerDay": -2 },
    { "From": -8, "To": -4, "PerDay": -4 },
    { "From": -10, "To": -8, "PerDay": -6 }
  ],
  "Talk": [
    { "From": -4, "To": 0, "Gain": 20 },
    { "From": -8, "To": -4, "Gain": 10 },
    { "From": -10, "To": -8, "Gain": 5 }
  ],
  "Gift": [
    { "From": -4, "To": 0, "Loved": 250, "Liked": 45, "NeutralTaste": 20, "Disliked": -20, "Hated": -40 },
    { "From": -10, "To": -4, "Loved": 250, "Liked": 45, "NeutralTaste": 20, "Disliked": -20, "Hated": -40 }
  ]
}[/code]Any range not defined in config will use vanilla behavior.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]▌ Console Commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]relationship_status [NPC|all][/b] — Check current points and heart count[/*]
[*][b]relationship_set [NPC] [points][/b] — Set points directly (debug)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]▌ GMCM Support[/b][/size]

If Generic Mod Config Menu is installed, all config values can be adjusted in-game via slider. The mod works fine without it.

[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/2jw6vtCh/3.png[/img][/center]

[b]Required:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0.0 or later — [url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Nexus[/url][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] — Required to use content packs — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Nexus[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] — For in-game config UI — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Nexus[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b]Steps:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the required mods above.[/*]
[*]Download [b]NegativeHearts[/b] from the Files tab and extract it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b] folder.[/*]
[*](Optional) Download [b]NegativeHearts ExamplePack[/b] from the Files tab and install it the same way.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    ├── NegativeHearts/
    │  ├── manifest.json
    │  ├── NegativeHearts.dll
    │  ├── assets/
    │  └── i18n/
    └── NegativeHearts.ExamplePack/  ← optional
        ├── manifest.json
        ├── content.json
        └── i18n/[/code]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/TY1RbY7v/4.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Example Pack languages:[/b] English and Korean only. The main mod supports multiple languages via i18n, but translations may be inaccurate as they were machine-translated. Corrections are welcome.[/*]
[*][b]Neutral zone protection:[/b] Config rules do not apply above −1 heart (−499 points). Vanilla behavior is preserved in this range.[/*]
[*][b]Uninstalling:[/b] Negative friendship values remain in the save file. Vanilla will clamp them back to 0 on load. Your save will not be corrupted.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pTswVKth/5.png[/img][/center]

[b]Q: Does this mod add dialogue or events by itself?[/b]
A: No. The mod only provides the system. Dialogue and events must come from a separate Content Patcher pack. The Example Pack included on this page is a reference implementation for all 37 vanilla NPCs.

[b]Q: Can I make my own content pack?[/b]
A: Yes! Download the Example Pack, use it as a reference, and create your own CP pack with custom dialogue and events. See the Example Pack's content.json and i18n files for the structure.

[b]Q: Is this compatible with NPC mods?[/b]
A: The Harmony patches apply to all NPCs. Custom NPCs should work as long as they follow standard SMAPI conventions.

[b]Q: Can I install or remove this mid-playthrough?[/b]
A: Yes. Existing saves are fully compatible. Removing the mod clamps all negative values back to 0 — your save will not be damaged.

[b]Q: Where can I report bugs or give feedback?[/b]
A: Please use the bug report tab on this page. For general questions, feel free to message Asakohee on [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall]the Stardew Valley Korean community.[/url]
